name: evaluation-packet
title: Evaluation decision packet
for_each: select id,name from runs order by name

sections.title: Run and recorded coverage
sections.note: Saved evidence, not release authorisation. Ask for current results before making a decision.

sections.title: Case outcomes
sections.sql: select x.case_key,x.cohort,x.passed,x.reason,x.latency_ms from run_summary s join evaluations e on e.id=s.evaluation_id cross join lateral jsonb_to_recordset(e.results) as x(case_key text,cohort text,passed boolean,reason text,latency_ms integer) where s.id=$1 order by x.case_key

sections.title: Decision evidence
sections.sql: select v.actor,v.decision,v.evidence,v.created_at from reviews v join evaluations e on e.id=v.evaluation_id where e.run_id=$1 order by v.created_at,v.id

sections.title: Follow-up work
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,status,resolution from action_queue where id in (select id from actions where run_id=$1) order by due,id

name: data-handling-review
title: Data handling review
for_each: select id,name from projects order by name

sections.title: Purpose and accountability
sections.note: Due dates are local review policy. Privacy law sets no universal number of days here.

sections.title: Registered suites
sections.sql: select name,version,review_due from suites where project_id=$1 order by name,version
